model_vision.description: Cloud models that read handwriting and math from a photo, comma-separated. The first is preferred, the rest are backups.

model_text.description: Cloud models for organizing notes and writing hints, comma-separated. The first is preferred, the rest are backups.

long_input_chars.description: Above this many characters, a text task prefers the cloud over the local model.

daily_cloud_cap.description: Cloud calls per device per day. After that, the device or the queue takes over.
